name: Spaghetti with Turkey Bolognese
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and discard the ends of the celery; small dice the celery and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the celery.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the celery and onion to the pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, 2 to 4 minutes.
While the vegetables cook, pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add the garlic to the pan; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Once the water is boiling, season with salt and add the pasta. Cook the pasta until desired firmness, 8 to 10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander.
Add the ground turkey to the pan; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 2 to 4 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and tomato sauce to the pan; season with salt, pepper, and crushed red pepper. Increase the heat to medium-high and let the sauce simmer until thickened, 4 to 6 minutes.
Stir the basil and spaghetti into the sauce.
To serve, place the pasta into a bowl. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
